newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues says wins 1 bln Ffr HK contract.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues says wins 1 bln Ffr HK contract.

text.p: French construction group Bouygues said on Friday it had won a contract worth in the region of one billion francs in Hong Kong to build the headquarters of Cathay Pacific in Chek Lap Kok, the site of Hong Kong's future airport.

Bouygues said in a statement the contract was worth HK $1.62 billion and involved building 73,000 square metres of offices, a building with 300 rooms for Cathay staff and a leisure centre of 4,000 squre metres plus 3,200 quare metres of work space.
It said the work would begin at the end of October and take about 22 months to complete.

Bouygues' share price, which was around 0.59 percent up ahead of the announcement, was up 1.76 percent at 520 francs shortly afterwards, at 1356 GMT, while the CAC-40 leading share index was up 0.68 percent at the same time.
